checks.name: held-out-full-core-and-adapter
checks.command: cargo test --locked --manifest-path truelearner/Cargo.toml -p truelearner-core && cargo test --locked --manifest-path research/experiments/developmental-hand-construction-admission/Cargo.toml

findings: No new core diagnostic event was required; the research adapter now preserves existing local-selection, causal-origin, return-origin, consequence-write, and closure-eligibility event details instead of reducing them to counts.
At first upper clamp both physical motors had live threshold-crossing candidates; one was rejected by local output competition while the consequential incumbent was admitted and emitted.
Repeated clamped sensor origins wrote fresh consequence even when existing closure eligibility classified them as pre-opening and ineligible, localizing the first consumer mismatch.
All three frozen diagnostic arms survived with exact replay, natural quiescence, zero propagation exhaustion, and a 0.26-second representative warm suite.
residual_uncertainty: The diagnostic establishes the first failed transition but does not establish a sufficient release mechanism.
The reflected lower-boundary control remains deferred until a local physical change-versus-resampling discriminator exists.
